items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: In the Panther Room, they had Harry James' band and Frank Sinatra, so we worked with them for about a month.

ctx.x: Betty Grable. She, uh...They came down there to see me. We had a good time. So he went back and told Frank. So, the next week, Frank Sinatra came down, an' I was so busy after them chicks out there an' I didn't have time to talk to Frank Sinatra too much, so he got angry and left. Fact, he just got fed up, so he left, and that the last time I seen him...outside o' in the movies.
You suppose he was upset because the chicks were payin' attention to you instead o' him?
